capabilities.heading: What Can Kling AI Do?
capabilities.sub: A quick look at what's actually in Kling AI today — this gets re-checked regularly as new model versions ship.

items.title: Text-to-Video & Image-to-Video
items.text: Describe a scene or animate a still image into motion, at up to 1080p and 48fps.

items.title: Motion Brush & Camera Control
items.text: Direct exactly how the camera pans, tilts or zooms, and which parts of the frame move — real creative control, not just a random result.

items.title: Synchronized Audio
items.text: Kling 2.6 and later generate matching audio in the same pass as the video, so you're not bolting on sound separately.

items.title: Long-Form Generation
items.text: The Pro tier renders continuous clips up to two minutes long, instead of stitching short segments together.

items.title: Character & Style Consistency
items.text: Upload a reference photo or video so a subject's appearance and motion stay consistent across multiple shots.

items.title: Negative Prompting
items.text: Tell it exactly what to avoid — blurry textures, warped limbs — for cleaner results on the first try.
